assets.people: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent character sprite atlas for a 2D pixel art RPG set in London circa 1850. Create exactly FOUR separate full-body small chibi pixel characters, each facing forward, matching classic detailed GBA RPG sprites with about 3-head-tall proportions, deliberate crisp pixels and warm muted palette. Four equally sized cells in a precise 2 columns x 2 rows atlas. Every character centered in its own cell, feet at 92% cell height, all same character scale and height, generous transparent padding, no cell borders, no text, no shadows or background. TOP LEFT: adult male railway luggage porter, burgundy waistcoat over cream shirt, navy flat cap, brown trousers, hand carrying small leather luggage. TOP RIGHT: teenage newspaper seller, charcoal flat cap, olive jacket, rust scarf, tan satchel, folded newspapers in hand. BOTTOM LEFT: adult London woman, muted teal Victorian dress, cream bonnet, little basket. BOTTOM RIGHT: male commuter, dark brown long coat and modest black top hat, rolled document. Must be professional detailed pixel art, NOT vector art, NOT smooth painted illustration, not photorealistic. True transparent alpha.
